sourceTitle: Phyllo pie with apples and pears
sourceText:
Phyllo pie with apples and pears
By: Easy cook - Lak...
Published: Sunday, February 17, 2013 - 8:11am

Ingredients




80g dried cranberries
5ml rum
4 apples
2 pears
1 lemon, juice and zest
1 tbs Muscovado brown sugar
¼ tsp ground cinnamon
2 tbs corn flour
70g butter, melted
4 sheets phyllo pastry
80g sugar

Preparation

1 Soak the cranberries in rum while preparing the fruit. 2 Wash, peel and cut into bite size pieces apples and pears. 3 Sprinkle with lemon and lemon zest, mix. 4 Sprinkle the fruit with Muscovado, cinnamon and corn flour, mix and combine. 5 Add cranberries and rum, mix and combine. 6 Grease with butter a ø20 cm spring form pan. Butter smeared movable form cake diameter of 20 cm. 7 Place the first phyllo sheet at the base of the form leaving the parts of the sheet to hang over the pan edge. 8 Sprinkle the sheet with 1 teaspoon of sugar. Repeat this with the second sheet put in cross with the first one. Continue until all 4 sheets are used. 9 Fill the form with the fruit and cover it with the turned in edges of the first sheet.  Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with sugar. Repeat until all the edges are used. 10 When the fruit is completely covered, butter the phyllo once more and liberally sprinkle with sugar. 11 Bake in preheated oven at 190˚C for 45 minutes. After the first 20 minutes cover the pie with the Alu foil to avoid burning and continue baking for the next 25 minutes. 12 After baking, leave the cake to cool in the pan, then carefully remove it onto a serving platter. Serve lukewarm or completely cool.

About

Delicious and easy to make.

Elle est super gourmande cette tarte et légère avec les feuilles Phyllo. Hum !!

Dear Belle, apparently from Walmart. It's stocked with the frozen pie crusts etc. Also, in every grocery store, ask for phyllo sheets for bakhlava.
